messages:
Priya: Quick alert — a big seed batch went out and ~2.8k trial owners got duplicate playbook touches. Owners are confused about SLA handoffs. Need fast mitigation.
Alex: Short-term fix: suppress seed sends for any owner with a manual outreach in the last 7d. Also tag seed_source for filtering. :thumbsup: 
Jordan: Root cause: legacy-import + webhook replays. Recommend dedupe key at ingestion = email|account_id|source_hash. Quick check SQL: ```SELECT account_id, email, count(*) FROM playbook_touch WHERE seed=true GROUP BY account_id, email HAVING count(*)>1;```
Maya: If we just suppress, health_score might oscillate. Suggest freezing seed weight in healthscore for 72h after a seed touch so metrics stay stable.
Priya: Proposed rollout: 1) ingest dedupe by email|account_id|source_hash 2) suppression rule: skip if last_manual_touch >= now() - interval '7 days' 3) apply healthscore freeze tag 'seed' for 72h 4) dry-run on staging.
Alex: Paste a compact playbook JSON and I'll push to staging for a dry run.
Priya: Playbook snippet: ```{"playbook":"seed-curation","rules":[{"name":"dedupe_ingest","type":"ingest","key":"email|account_id|source_hash"},{"name":"owner_suppress","type":"suppression","condition":"last_manual_touch >= interval '7 days'","action":"skip"},{"name":"health_freeze","type":"metric_override","metric":"health_score","duration":"72h","scope":"tag:seed"}],"dry_run":true}```
Jordan: I'll add a post-process that exports any remaining duplicates to CSV and ping #cs-ops for manual cleanup.
CS Bot: Dry-run deployed to staging for playbook=seed-curation. Estimated matches=142. No live sends. deploy_id=stg-seedcurate-2791234567 :robot_face:
Maya: After validation, can we add a dashboard widget showing outreach volume delta + 7d health_score delta so Enablement and PS can monitor impact?
Alex: I'll review staging tomorrow and pair with Priya on rollout checklist.
Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll add the checklist to ops doc and tag the reviewers. :sparkles:
